name: Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen

submission.postalAddress: Landesbeauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit Nordrhein-Westfalen, Postfach 20 04 44, 40102 Düsseldorf, Germany

procedural.notes: The LDI NRW is competent for controllers established in North Rhine-Westphalia (private sector and NRW state public bodies). The authority publishes a downloadable PDF complaint form (Beschwerdeformular) that can be submitted by email to poststelle@ldi.nrw.de, by fax, or by post to Postfach 20 04 44, 40102 Düsseldorf — there is no JavaScript webform. PGP encryption is offered for sensitive submissions. Working language is German.
